use_case: Use the estimate request form during electrical service diagnosis and controlled repair when the electrical service record must identify panel, circuit, voltage, load, disconnect, equipment served, labels, and occupancy impact. Complete the applicable handoff for functional test, label update, energized release, customer explanation, permit result, and service record.
